features.name: One modular AUG-CSL family, supplied in a large component briefcase; basic weapon is assault rifle and components support AR/SMG/rifle/LMG configurations.
ALL configurations retain integral top laser, barrel-mounted gas-vent1 system and RIGID stock. They share assault-rifle ammunition but use different feed clips/configurations.
Own AUGCSL family picture printed27/PDF29 supplies the broad body, rear stock opening, forward grip/support and upper laser unit; it does not individually label all four configurations.

Root inspected the prepared overlay against the single accepted raw pair. Paired silhouette and landmarks remain aligned; each source mask retains its own components/openings, with no discarded components or filled holes. Thin members and structural openings retained. Fine grooves/seams are nonblocking. Native1254 images retained;2048 is resampled, not native2K. Compared own labeled isolated AUG-CSL family art Arsenal27/PDF29 and176/PDF178 configuration table with actual corrected343detail and matching345clay. Low continuous tapered body/rigidstock,ONE main grip with clear OPEN triggerguard/retainedtrigger,narrow separate forward grip,small SOLID raised laser,slender exposed muzzle-right barrel and20-round REARclip retained. No false carryhandle,scope,launcher,belt,bipod or duplicate grip. Exact clip contour,finish and hidden depth are disclosed artistic interpretation. Matching silhouette/framing/openings inspected once;minor shallow grooves and harmless edge fringe nonblocking. Native1254RGBA originals retained;2048conditioning is resampled,not native2K. No geometry/client/production approval.
